_about: Behaviour rules of the circuit tracer (docs/harness/tools/trace_circuits.py; OPEN-ITEMS row 117; Dan A54 a, 2026-11-15).

The master wire list says where every wire goes. This file says only what the master cannot: what a part IS (switch, relay, diode, load, factory end point), when a switch is closed and when an ECU output is on.

Every line carries its source in 'src': a DECISIONS id, a Dan answer, a datasheet, sot/* or the master's own pin text. Nothing here is guessed: what the repo does not say is 'TBD' and is reported as 'not proven'.
A factory part is only an end point our wire lands on (Dan A57 a): a source, a ground (sink), a switch or a load. Nothing here checks a factory circuit.
A change to this file needs Dan's yes (A54 a).
'exceptions': a finding Dan accepted by name (check + device). The tracer lists it under 'Accepted exceptions' and does not count it as a finding.

Expressions ('when', 'on_when') use the scenario inputs and the derived names below, plus hot('ID:pin') = that pin is on a hard supply, low('ID:pin') = on a hard ground, on('K-X') = relay closed, lit('DEV.element') = that load is on.

exceptions.why: the starter B+ cable has no fuse by design: a starter B+ cable is unfused in every car, Toyota's own included; the battery kill switch protects it
